reviewed.name: cachedLogsMaxCount
reviewed.reason: Caches settings.logsMaxCount for one second. A number, no data. It is 0 on the warm runtime: DEFAULT_LOGS_MAX_COUNT is 0, and only the REST settings handlers (never run by the plugin) and user scripts (isolated runtime only) write settings. At 0, appendLogEntry returns before it formats or stores the message, so a credential in a "Failed to parse line" error is never kept.
